answer: An agent rendering exchange commissions a GPU kernel for a tundra scene with jade reflections on the ice. Each solver commits a code hash and bond before seeing other submissions. Hidden scenes test pixel accuracy and runtime; the contract pays only for a new verified speed improvement, keyed to normalized compiler output rather than a wallet. Copies and cosmetic renames share one payout, while false performance claims lose the bond. A Sybil farm needs a real optimization for each extra reward.
